portInfo.description: Seehafen Wismar GmbH presents itself as a Baltic logistics gateway for Scandinavia–Central Europe cargo with intermodal rail/road links; the English homepage has no cruise berth facts table. Contact phone published: +49 3841 452-0. The Hansestadt Wismar Hafenamt site covers the public/municipal harbour administration. Because a dedicated cruise-terminal operator and 2026 call list were not confirmed from primary pages here, this guide refuses to invent pier names, LOA or walk times. The city’s UNESCO heritage remains the reason a cruise product would matter — contingent on a verified landing.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Markt / old town brick Gothic — ~120 min if landing confirmed.
Harbour waterfront — proximity depends on berth.
Day trip Rostock/Schwerin — only with long calls; not verified.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask the line whether Wismar is still offering a passenger call and which quay — seaport marketing is cargo-first.
